sections.heading: Confirm coverage at the scene
paragraphs: Ask for insurance card photos and verify policy status. In Long Beach, uninsured motorist rates track with statewide averages — always assume minimum limits until verified.

sections.heading: Your UM/UIM policy in California
paragraphs: Uninsured/underinsured motorist coverage on your policy may pay when the at-fault driver has no coverage or insufficient 30/60/15 limits.
Notify your carrier promptly; UM claims still require documentation of injuries and damages.

sections.heading: Hit-and-run steps in Long Beach
paragraphs: Report hit-and-runs immediately to Long Beach police. UM coverage often requires a police report within 24–72 hours.
Seek witnesses and camera footage near Long Beach downtown interchange.

sections.heading: Medical and financial documentation

sections.heading: When litigation may be necessary
paragraphs: If UM/UIM carriers deny or lowball offers, a licensed California attorney can evaluate bad-faith and negligence claims against the at-fault driver directly.

sections.heading: Long Beach medical resources after a crash
paragraphs: Long Beach residents often use Long Beach Regional Medical Center, Long Beach General Hospital after serious collisions. Level I trauma care is available at Long Beach Level I Trauma Center.
Document every provider visit — gaps in treatment are a common reason CA insurers reduce settlement offers.
Keep receipts for prescriptions, imaging (MRI/CT), physical therapy, and medical transport.
list: Photograph visible injuries the same day when safe
Follow discharge instructions and keep all after-visit summaries
Do not sign blanket medical authorizations for the adjuster

sections.heading: Settlement timeline expectations in Long Beach
paragraphs: Minor property-damage claims in Long Beach may resolve in weeks, but injury claims involving treatment, lost wages, or disputed fault often take months. Insurers may request recorded statements, independent medical exams, and broad medical authorizations — review each request carefully.
California uses Pure comparative comparative negligence with a 2-year statute of limitations for most injury cases. Calendar your deadline from the date of injury.

If you were transported from I-95 to Long Beach Regional Medical Center, keep ambulance, ER, and follow-up bills organized. UM/UIM and MedPay endorsements may apply when the other driver is underinsured.
list: Do not accept the first settlement check if treatment is ongoing
Avoid discussing fault on social media
Request adjuster denials or reservations of rights in writing
Compare repair estimates with your insurer's appraisal
Consult a licensed attorney before signing general releases

sections.heading: Document checklist for Long Beach claims
paragraphs: Organize a folder (physical or digital) for every document tied to your Long Beach crash: police report number, insurance claim numbers, tow and storage receipts, and rental car agreements.
Request itemized medical bills from Long Beach Regional Medical Center rather than summary statements — itemized bills help catch billing errors and support future negotiations.
list: Photos of all vehicles and the scene from multiple angles
Employer note for any missed work shifts
Insurance adjuster name, phone, and claim number
Repair estimates from at least two body shops
